summary: Filing: Form 8-K (Item 8.01 Other Events) – Lamar Advertising Company announces a regular quarterly cash dividend of $1.60 per share, payable June 30, 2026, to holders of record June 16, 2026, for Class A and Class B common stock. The board expects aggregate 2026 quarterly distributions to total at least $6.40 per common share. This is a routine dividend declaration with no structural change, activism, or corporate action. The filing is a standard current report on dividend policy and contains no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic reviews. Nothing to watch or arbitrage here.
